format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-tree-item value="root" label="Корень" open><sf-tree-item value="images" label="Изображения"></sf-tree-item><sf-tree-item value="doc" label="Договор.pdf" kind="file"></sf-tree-item></sf-tree-item>
<sf-tree id="n" aria-label="Ссылки"><sf-tree-item value="x" label="Пункт" kind="file"></sf-tree-item><sf-tree-item value="y" label="Ещё" kind="file"></sf-tree-item></sf-tree>
<sf-tree id="s" aria-label="Старое слово" selection="single"><sf-tree-item value="p" label="П" kind="file"></sf-tree-item></sf-tree>
<sf-tree id="m" aria-label="Несколько" selection="many"><sf-tree-item value="a" label="А" kind="file"></sf-tree-item><sf-tree-item value="c" label="В" kind="file"></sf-tree-item></sf-tree>

probes.title: the entries are flat rows with their level, set size and place; one Tab stop
probes.covers: role tree, items from markup, aria-level, roving tab stop, text alias

steps.check: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#t [role=treeitem]')]; const level = (v) => document.querySelector(`#t [data-value=${v}]`).getAttribute('aria-level'); return document.querySelector('#t > .sf-tree[role=tree]').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Папки' && rows.length === 5 && level('images') === '2' && level('b') === '1' && document.querySelector('#t [data-value=doc]').getAttribute('aria-posinset') === '2' && document.querySelector('#t [data-value=b] .sf-tree-item-name').textContent.trim() === 'Второй' && rows.filter((r) => r.tabIndex === 0).length === 1 && !document.querySelector('#t sf-tree-item'); })()

probes.title: the chevron closes a branch: sf-tree-toggle {id, open}, then the dated sf-tree-item-toggle
the arrows walk the visible rows; ArrowRight opens and enters, ArrowLeft returns; Home, End and a letter
probes.covers: keyboard ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home, End, typeahead

steps.script: (document.activeElement.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Д', bubbles: true, composed: true})), true)

probes.title: a press selects one entry: sf-tree-select {ids, id, selected}, then the dated sf-tree-selection-change
selection single is one's dated value alias; many toggles each entry with Space and holds selected-ids
probes.covers: settings.selection, aliases.json single/multiple, values.selected-ids, keyboard Space

probes.title: a press on a name asks to open the entry: sf-tree-open {id, value}, then the dated sf-tree-item-click
expand and collapse answer outcomes; a leaf refuses
a new items with one entry changed rewrites that row in place; the others keep their elements and the open state survives
probes.covers: settings.items (entries keyed by id, changes: content), entry-state open (§18.1, §18.4)

steps.script: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#n'); window.__kept = t.querySelector('[data-value=y]'); window.__changed = t.querySelector('[data-value=x]'); t.items = [{label: 'Пункт переименован', value: 'x', kind: 'file'}, {label: 'Ещё', value: 'y', kind: 'file'}]; return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#n'); return t.querySelector('[data-value=y]') === window.__kept && t.querySelector('[data-value=x]') === window.__changed && window.__changed.querySelector('.sf-tree-item-name').textContent.trim() === 'Пункт переименован'; })()

probes.title: over 300 visible entries only those in view are drawn, window {first, last} is said, and focus-entry draws a far entry before focusing it

steps.script: (() => { window.__win = []; const t = document.querySelector('#big'); t.addEventListener('sf-tree-window', (e) => window.__win.push(e.detail)); t.items = Array.from({length: 40}, (_, g) => ({label: `Папка ${g + 1}`, value: `f${g}`, open: true, children: Array.from({length: 49}, (_, c) => ({label: `Документ ${g + 1}.${c + 1}`, value: `f${g}-${c}`, kind: 'file'}))})); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#big [role=treeitem]').length; return rows > 0 && rows < 100 && window.__win.length > 0 && window.__win.at(-1).first === 0 && document.querySelectorAll('#big .sf-tree-spacer').length === 1; })()
